# === Agno (lightweight framework) ===
# pip install agno duckduckgo-search
from agno.agent import Agent
from agno.models.openai import OpenAIChat
from agno.tools.duckduckgo import DuckDuckGoTools

agent = Agent(
    model=OpenAIChat(id="gpt-4o-mini"),
    tools=[DuckDuckGoTools()],
    show_tool_calls=True
)
agent.print_response("Who won the 2024 Tour de France?")
description: Agno agent with OpenAIChat model and DuckDuckGoTools for web search, show_tool_calls displays the tool interactions.
